scope: Synthetic users with separate cache scopes. Staff each authorized for one of 20 stores (4000 orders/store); admins authorized for all 80000 orders. Actual current order handler and SQL, signed synthetic session and actual get_workbench_user SQL against 500 seeded database accounts (when CAPACITY_DB_ACCOUNTS=1), with fixture store grants, Waitress32 / DB pool6 / isolated MySQL128MiB. Each user starts a request every 5s when the previous request has completed; slow requests run immediately on completion (no overlapping requests per user). 500 account identities, five 100-user cohorts, synchronized cold starts. Mixed profile: 90% store-scoped staff and 10% full-dataset admins. Every6 requests:3 list,1 summary,1 search,1 next-page. 65s stages deliberately include keyword search and multiple cache expiry cycles. No real background jobs or external APIs. Closed-loop model underdelivers target traffic when slow.
